integrity.proof_basis: Exact incidence factorization, indefinite restricted-form rank lemma, parity classification and reversal anticommutation; supplemental finite numerical diagnostics only.

scientific_limitations: Connected finite simple graphs of minimum degree at least three; unnormalized nonbacktracking matrix. No exact irregular eigenvalues or generalization to normalized, directed, or weighted graphs. Historical priority is subject to unindexed prior literature.
title: Reciprocal-degree balance and complete signed inertia of nonbacktracking self-commutators
